remarks:
Turnkey ranch perfectly positioned on a generous corner lot in one of the most coveted neighborhoods in Jamestown. Impeccably maintained and thoughtfully updated, this residence offers incredible peace of mind with recent upgrades including a newer roof, fresh paint, modern central air, and newer lower level windows. Step inside to discover a sun drenched open floorplan designed for effortless modern living. Beautifully refinished hardwood floors flow seamlessly throughout the main level. The spacious living room is anchored by a stunning fireplace that brings warmth and texture to the space while opening directly into the dining area to create an ideal environment for entertaining.

The sleek kitchen is a home chef dream featuring gorgeous granite countertops, newer appliances, a versatile movable center island, and abundant storage including a dedicated closet pantry. Down the hall, the primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat complete with dual double closets and a convenient private half bath. Two additional bright bedrooms share a beautifully updated full bathroom showcasing a luxurious walk in tiled shower. Maximize your living space in the finished lower level which hosts an expansive family room, a flexible bonus room perfect for overnight guests, and an additional half bath paired with a separate walk in shower.

Step outside to experience your own private outdoor sanctuary. The fully fenced backyard guarantees total privacy while you lounge by the heated inground pool. A spacious patio complete with a dedicated gas line makes summer entertaining effortless. With prime access to local schools, parks, downtown attractions, UPMC, and major highways, this exceptional property perfectly balances tranquil residential living with ultimate convenience. Schedule your private tour today and step into your next chapter.
